findings.issue_text: [High/bug] src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py:10 — `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate])` is now just `pass` and implements none of the abstract methods it inherits (`get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly-added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`), so the class can no longer be instantiated — any `Detector` of this type resolving `detector.detector_handler` will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. This is a regression from the previous version, which had a concrete `evaluate` and was instantiable.

[Medium/bug] tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py:~539 (`TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`) — the expected occurrence is built via `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", 6, ...)` but `expected_result` (and the unchanged `evaluate_group_key_value` invocation) use group key "group_key"; since `build_fingerprint` embeds the group key in the occurrence's fingerprint, the expected occurrence can never equal the one the handler actually builds, so this assertion fails as written.

[Low/test_gap] tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py (`test_state_results_multi_group`, `TestEvaluate.test_results_on_change`, `TestEvaluate.test_dedupe`) — expected occurrences are built with a hardcoded `value=6` that doesn't match the values actually evaluated (10, 100, and 8 respectively); because the mock `build_occurrence_and_event_data`/helper ignores `value`, the tests pass anyway, so the `value` passed to `build_occurrence_and_event_data` is never actually verified, and this copy-paste pattern will silently mask value-wiring bugs once a real implementation puts the value into evidence data.

[Low/doc_defect] src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:~228 — `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate`'s docstring still says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`" after this PR changed the return type to a dict keyed by group key; the docstring should be updated to match the new contract.

[Low/doc_defect] src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py:9 — the comment `# TODO: This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction` is now stale/misleading: this same change makes the class a `StatefulDetectorHandler` subclass (albeit an unimplemented one).

goldens.comment: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler but only contains pass, failing to implement its required abstract methods: counter_names (property), get_dedupe_value(), get_group_key_values(), and build_occurrence_and_event_data(). This will cause a TypeError at runtime when the class is instantiated.
Docstring says this returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult, but the method now returns a dict keyed by DetectorGroupKey. Consider updating the docstring to match the new return type.

Wrong value `6` passed for `group_2` occurrence — the data packet specifies `"group_2": 10`. Should be `10` to accurately reflect the test scenario, which will ensure the test produces the correct occurrence data.

adjudication.rationale: In `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`, the test constructs `occurrence, event_data = build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", ...)`, but then sets `expected_result = DetectorEvaluationResult("group_key", ...)` and (per the unchanged test structure) calls `evaluate_group_key_value` using the group key `"group_key"`. `build_mock_occurrence_and_event` calls `handler.build_fingerprint(group_key)`, so the occurrence built for `"val1"` cannot match the handler-produced occurrence for `"group_key"`, making the assertion fail as written.
